body:
## 操作环境
平台隔离Linux、Terraform 1.13.5、Python3。所有命令仅作用于本题临时目录；无云账号、无远程服务。

## 操作任务
使用内置terraform_data.record记录var.label，根输出label读取record.output。完成init、validate、plan、apply、state pull、无变化plan、变更输入后plan以及destroy。解释配置、provider、state和plan各自的作用；这是Terraform内置资源，不是云资源替身。

## 产物
- main.tf
仅修改上述交付文件，保留其余材料；不得添加远程模块、云provider或provisioner。

## 验收方法
平台实际运行Terraform init/validate/plan/show；涉及state的题额外实际执行apply/import/state。输入变化与重复执行分别验收。此合同只验证明确的本地Terraform语义，不代表云端部署或原生产故障复现。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import contextlib,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
FILES=['main.tf']
FIXED={}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, 'readonly material changed'
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith(('.tf','.tf.json')) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith('checks/')}
assert actual=={n for n in FILES if n.endswith(('.tf','.tf.json'))}, 'unexpected configuration file'
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(values=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-tf-') as name:
  root=pathlib.Path(name)/'root';root.mkdir();mirror=pathlib.Path(name)/'empty';mirror.mkdir()
  for n in FILES:
   p=root/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes((BASE/n).read_bytes())
  rc=pathlib.Path(name)/'terraform.rc';rc.write_text('disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation { filesystem_mirror { path = '+json.dumps(str(mirror))+' } }\n')
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('TF_')}
  env.update(TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE=str(rc),TF_IN_AUTOMATION='1',TF_INPUT='0',CHECKPOINT_DISABLE='1')
  def run(args,good=True):
   p=subprocess.run(['terraform',*args],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
   with (BASE/'native-cli-trace.jsonl').open('a') as trace:
    trace.write(json.dumps({'command':['terraform',*args],'cwd':str(root),'rc':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr},ensure_ascii=True)+'\n')
   if good: assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run(['init','-backend=false','-input=false','-no-color'])
  assert json.loads(run(['validate','-json']).stdout)['valid']
  if values is not None: (root/'case.auto.tfvars.json').write_text(json.dumps(values))
  yield root,run
def plan(values):
 with work(values) as (root,run):
  run(['plan','-input=false','-lock=false','-no-color','-out=plan.bin'])
  d=json.loads(run(['show','-json','plan.bin']).stdout)
  assert not d.get('resource_changes'),'pure expression exercise must not create resources'
  def inspect(m):
   assert not m.get('resources'),'resource configuration is outside scope'
   for call in m.get('module_calls',{}).values():
    assert call['source'].startswith('./modules/'),'remote module outside scope'
    inspect(call['module'])
  module=d.get('configuration',{}).get('root_module',{})
  inspect(module)
  pass
  return {k:v['value'] for k,v in d.get('planned_values',{}).get('outputs',{}).items()}
with work({'label':'first'}) as (root,run):
 run(['apply','-auto-approve','-input=false','-no-color'])
 assert json.loads(run(['output','-json']).stdout)['label']['value']=='first'
 state=json.loads(run(['state','pull']).stdout)
 record=next((r for r in state['resources'] if r['type']=='terraform_data' and r['name']=='record'),None)
 assert record is not None,'required resource missing'
 assert record['instances'][0]['attributes']['input']['value']=='first' and record['instances'][0]['attributes']['output']['value']=='first','record did not receive and persist the input'
 assert run(['plan','-detailed-exitcode','-input=false','-no-color'],False).returncode==0
 (root/'case.auto.tfvars.json').write_text(json.dumps({'label':'second'}))
 assert run(['plan','-detailed-exitcode','-input=false','-no-color'],False).returncode==2
 run(['apply','-auto-approve','-input=false','-no-color'])
 assert json.loads(run(['output','-json']).stdout)['label']['value']=='second'
 assert run(['plan','-detailed-exitcode','-input=false','-no-color'],False).returncode==0
 state=json.loads(run(['state','pull']).stdout)
 record=next(r for r in state['resources'] if r['type']=='terraform_data' and r['name']=='record')
 assert record['instances'][0]['attributes']['input']['value']=='second' and record['instances'][0]['attributes']['output']['value']=='second','record input/output did not follow changed input'
 import secrets
 sentinel='review-output-'+secrets.token_hex(12)
 record['instances'][0]['attributes']['output']['value']=sentinel
 state['serial']+=1
 (root/'review-sentinel.tfstate').write_text(json.dumps(state))
 run(['state','push','review-sentinel.tfstate'])
 run(['plan','-refresh=false','-input=false','-no-color','-out=sentinel.plan'])
 planned=json.loads(run(['show','-json','sentinel.plan']).stdout)
 assert planned['planned_values']['outputs']['label']['value']==sentinel,'root output bypasses resource output'
 run(['destroy','-auto-approve','-input=false','-no-color'])
 assert run(['state','list']).stdout.strip()==''

print("Session04 native Terraform contract complete")

title: 把变量声明放入正确根模块，验证目录与文件加载范围
answer:
### variables.tf
```hcl
variable "label" {
 type = string
 default = "root-default"
}

```

根目录main.tf引用var.label，但根目录尚未声明该输入。只补variables.tf：string类型、默认root-default。examples/variables.tf属于另一个未调用目录，不能作为根模块声明；operator-notes.tf.txt是普通文档，也不应删除或改写成合法HCL。实际执行默认、显式覆盖、空字符串三种plan，并让可信验收改变未调用示例目录的默认值，根结果仍应保持不变。

## 原理与原题解答
Terraform configuration 是描述资源目标状态、输入变量、provider、数据源和模块的声明式配置，通常使用 HCL。Terraform 结合 state 与 provider 读取的实际状态生成 plan；配置本身不是顺序执行的 shell 脚本。

原题：解释什么是"Terraform configuration"

## 操作环境
平台隔离Linux、Terraform 1.13.5、Python3。所有命令仅作用于本题临时目录；无云账号、无远程服务。

## 操作任务
交付只管理内置terraform_data.record的本地项目，输入secret和输出secret均标记sensitive，resource.input接收var.secret。可信验收用随机假秘密实际apply/state pull，证明终端掩码不代表state加密；改变值并检查备份与后续plan。提交答案需说明单机丢失、备份泄露、协作锁和远程后端访问控制的风险。严禁使用真实凭据。本题不宣称已验证远程后端锁。

## 产物
- main.tf
仅修改上述交付文件，保留其余材料；不得添加远程模块、云provider或provisioner。

## 验收方法
平台实际运行Terraform init/validate/plan/show；涉及state的题额外实际执行apply/import/state。输入变化与重复执行分别验收。此合同只验证明确的本地Terraform语义，不代表云端部署或原生产故障复现。

import contextlib,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
FILES=['main.tf']
FIXED={}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, 'readonly material changed'
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith(('.tf','.tf.json')) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith('checks/')}
assert actual=={n for n in FILES if n.endswith(('.tf','.tf.json'))}, 'unexpected configuration file'
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(values=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-tf-') as name:
  root=pathlib.Path(name)/'root';root.mkdir();mirror=pathlib.Path(name)/'empty';mirror.mkdir()
  for n in FILES:
   p=root/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes((BASE/n).read_bytes())
  rc=pathlib.Path(name)/'terraform.rc';rc.write_text('disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation { filesystem_mirror { path = '+json.dumps(str(mirror))+' } }\n')
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('TF_')}
  env.update(TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE=str(rc),TF_IN_AUTOMATION='1',TF_INPUT='0',CHECKPOINT_DISABLE='1')
  def run(args,good=True):
   p=subprocess.run(['terraform',*args],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
   with (BASE/'native-cli-trace.jsonl').open('a') as trace:
    trace.write(json.dumps({'command':['terraform',*args],'cwd':str(root),'rc':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr},ensure_ascii=True)+'\n')
   if good: assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run(['init','-backend=false','-input=false','-no-color'])
  assert json.loads(run(['validate','-json']).stdout)['valid']
  if values is not None: (root/'case.auto.tfvars.json').write_text(json.dumps(values))
  yield root,run
def plan(values):
 with work(values) as (root,run):
  run(['plan','-input=false','-lock=false','-no-color','-out=plan.bin'])
  d=json.loads(run(['show','-json','plan.bin']).stdout)
  assert not d.get('resource_changes'),'pure expression exercise must not create resources'
  def inspect(m):
   assert not m.get('resources'),'resource configuration is outside scope'
   for call in m.get('module_calls',{}).values():
    assert call['source'].startswith('./modules/'),'remote module outside scope'
    inspect(call['module'])
  module=d.get('configuration',{}).get('root_module',{})
  inspect(module)
  pass
  return {k:v['value'] for k,v in d.get('planned_values',{}).get('outputs',{}).items()}
import uuid
with work() as (root,run):
 for index in range(2):
  secret='fake-session04-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
  (root/'case.auto.tfvars.json').write_text(json.dumps({'secret':secret}))
  run(['plan','-input=false','-no-color','-out=secret-input.plan'])
  configured=json.loads(run(['show','-json','secret-input.plan']).stdout)
  assert configured['configuration']['root_module']['variables']['secret'].get('sensitive') is True,'secret input must be sensitive'
  run(['apply','-auto-approve','-input=false','-no-color'])
  state=json.loads(run(['state','pull']).stdout)
  records=[r for r in state['resources'] if r['type']=='terraform_data' and r['name']=='record']
  assert len(records)==1,'required state resource missing'
  record=records[0]
  assert record['instances'][0]['attributes']['input']['value']==secret
  assert state['outputs']['secret']['value']==secret and state['outputs']['secret']['sensitive'] is True
  assert run(['plan','-detailed-exitcode','-input=false','-no-color'],False).returncode==0
 assert (root/'terraform.tfstate.backup').exists()
 run(['destroy','-auto-approve','-input=false','-no-color'])
 assert run(['state','list']).stdout.strip()==''

print("Session04 native Terraform contract complete")
